interpretation: Sensitivity analysis of the registered intervention/envelope decision layer; it does not replace fresh N-body integrations.

effect.justification: An intervention must exceed the registered numerical/reference envelope on at least two orbital metrics; three times the noise envelope is the planning SESOI.

noise_estimation.description: Reference-envelope scale from timestep, initial representation and body-count variants.

test_definition: Simulate baseline, three reference variants and admissible interventions; rebuild the envelope and apply the exact two-of-three metric accessibility rule.
